Nora: Following up on the pricing segment from today's all-hands  collecting quick clarifications on credits, quotas, and rate limits.

Evan: Do promo/trial credits expire or roll?

Nora: Promo and trial credits expire (default 180 days). Enterprise grants can get custom TTLs via billing.

Priya: What's the default behavior when quota is hit? Hard block or soft degrade?

Nora: Default self-serve = soft mode: alerts + temporary throttling and a small unpaid overage cap. Enterprise can pick hard block.

Evan: How do rate limits interact with quota consumption on spikes?

Nora: Two-layer protection: rate limits (requests/sec) stop bursts; quotas track consumed units. Accepted requests still consume units; if units would go negative, return 402. Rate-limit returns 429.

Priya: Will SDKs expose remaining quota?

Nora: Yes  headers + SDK helpers. Example headers: X-RW-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RW-Quota-Remaining, X-RW-Quota-Reset.

OpsBot: Internal link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/pricing-v4 (internal).

Finance: Action: define units mapping (tokens -> units) by Fri.
